replayed.description: True when the same idempotencyKey and ops replayed an accepted result.

revision.description: Document revision after a successful batch, or the current revision when the batch was refused.

results.description: One entry per op, in order, carrying the id the op finally acted on including auto-allocated ids.

validation.description: ValidationSummary for the accepted document revision.

uiHint.description: Semantic rule section and item location for Extension focus.

errorCode.description: Stable failure code, e.g. revision.conflict, rules.entity.not-found, rules.variable.in-use, rules.formula.parse-failed, rules.formula.unknown-reference.
